extracted.name: Passionfruit & elderflower spritz
extracted.description: Serve guests this stylish passionfruit and elderflower spritz for a grown-up, alcohol-free party drink. It's fruity, fizzy and very festive
ingredient_lines: 1 tsp passion fruit seeds or a lime leaf (optional), to serve
instruction_lines: Make sure all the ingredients are well chilled before you start. Ideally chill a flute glass too. Pour all of the ingredients into your glass, taking your time when you add the sparkling water so it doesn’t overflow, then stir gently.
Drop in a few passion fruit seeds to garnish and a lime leaf, if you like.
